newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Skilled wins Telstra cable contract.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Skilled wins Telstra cable contract.

text.p: Manpower and engineering placment group Skilled Engineering Ltd said on Friday it had won an additional contract with state-owned Telstra Corp for cable TV connections associated with Telstra's broadband cable rollout.
Skilled said the contract had a headline revenue of A$45 million in the first year and was for an initial term of 12 months subject to earlier termination in certain circumstances.

"Skilled has continued to record good rates of revenue growth in the second half of calendar 1996 and this Telstra contract will assist in maintaining that rate of growth during 1997," the company said in a statement.
However Skilled said general margin pressures and one-off costs associated with the growth and diversification of its businesses were likely to restrain earnings per share.
The company said full details of its results for the half year to December 31, 1996 were expected to be released in early February 1997.
Skilled reported a net profit of 12.64 million in the year to June 30, 1996 compared to A$10.33 million in the previous year.
